name: Empyric Wellspring
summary: A non-Daemon Heretic Astartes Psyker that makes a Dark Pact gets +1 Strength on ranged attacks that phase; a non-Khorne Daemon Prince that makes a Dark Pact gets +2 Strength and +1 AP in melee.

name: Desperate Devotion
summary: A Damned unit with Dark Pacts that moves, advances or charges can make a Desperate Pact for +2 Move and +2 to Charge rolls that phase, but must first pass a Leadership test or suffer D3 mortal wounds.

name: Experimental Augmentations
summary: Before battle, pick or randomly roll augmentations for Heretic Astartes Infantry (not Damned) from a list granting bonuses such as +1 melee Attacks, +2" Move, +1 melee WS, +1 Toughness, +1 melee Strength or +1 ranged BS.

name: Soul Forge Boons
summary: Heretic Astartes Vehicle units gain the Daemon keyword. Vehicles, Lord Discordant, and Vashtorr also gain the Soul Forge keyword and a 5+ invulnerable save.

name: Masters of Misdirection
summary: At deployment, grant Infiltrators for the whole battle to a battle-size-limited number of Legionaries and Cultist Mob units (and their attached non-Epic-Hero Characters).

name: Terror Descends (Aura)
summary: Enemy units below Starting Strength within 12" of a friendly Heretic Astartes unit must take a Battle-shock test at -1, replacing any other Battle-shock test that phase.

name: Iron Fortitude
summary: Ranged attacks against a friendly Heretic Astartes unit (not Damned) get -1 to wound whenever the attack's Strength exceeds that unit's Toughness.

name: Tyrannical Motivation
summary: Each Command phase, grant all Heretic Astartes Infantry either +1 to hit or Fall Back and still shoot/charge until your next Command phase; units visible to Huron Blackheart get both for the phase.

name: Prey on the Weak
summary: Heretic Astartes Infantry Fly units re-roll Hit rolls of 1 against battle-shocked or half-strength targets, and get -1 to be hit by such targets. Exclusive Nightmare-tagged detachment.

name: Terror Made Manifest
summary: Under-strength enemies within 12" take one penalised Battle-shock test in the opponent's Command phase. Your attacks get +1 to hit half-strength targets and +1 to wound battle-shocked ones; being battle-shocked gives -1 to hit you.

name: Marks of Chaos
summary: Non-Epic-Hero Heretic Astartes units must be given a Chaos god keyword. On a successful Dark Pact, a unit's Lethal Hits or Sustained Hits 1 gain is upgraded per its god; Characters and Transports can only pair with matching keywords.

name: Raiders and Reavers
summary: Heretic Astartes ranged weapons gain Assault; their attacks against a unit within range of an objective marker get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Slaves to None
summary: Heretic Astartes models lose the Dark Pacts ability but their ranged weapons gain Assault; you cannot use the Cults of the Dark Gods rule when mustering your army.

name: Twisted Doctrine
summary: When moving a non-Battle-shocked Heretic Astartes unit, it can take a Battle-shock test to gain, until end of turn, either shoot-and-charge eligibility despite falling back, or charge eligibility despite advancing.

name: Vendetta
summary: Each Command phase, mark an enemy unit as your Vendetta target: Heretic Astartes attacks (not Damned) against it can re-roll the Hit roll until your next Command phase.

name: Debt to the Soul Forge
summary: A Heretic Astartes Daemon Vehicle making a Dark Pact can invoke its contract for -1 to that Leadership test, gaining +1 to wound on ranged attacks and +2 melee Attacks for the rest of the phase.

name: Focus of Hatred
summary: Each Command phase, name one enemy unit as your focus of hatred; Heretic Astartes (excluding Damned) attacks against it can re-roll the Hit roll until your next Command phase.

name: Warp Portals
summary: At the end of your opponent's turn, remove up to 1-3 (by battle size) Heretic Astartes Terminator, Obliterators or Mutilators units not in Engagement Range and place them into Strategic Reserves.
